name: TC_F11_FilterKeyAppliedToSearchReturnsResults
description:
Cross-feature integration flow:
  Step 1 — GET /filters for 'SON MOI' to retrieve available filter keys.
  Step 2 — Pick the first filter that has at least one value option.
  Step 3 — GET /search with that filter key=value appended as a query param.
Asserts the filtered search returns a valid 200 response with a non-null product list. Validates that filter keys returned by /filters are actually accepted by /search.
